hero_subtitle: Extract, analyse, and review tender documents with transparent processing. See confidence scores, warnings, and extraction results — all in one dashboard.
product_preview_title: Clear extraction results your team can actually review.
product_preview_desc: Tender Engine is designed to show useful automation and its limits in the same view.
executive_dashboard_desc: View a confidence-scored breakdown of every tender extraction. Completed stages, warnings, and failed items stay visible.
detailed_boq_pricing_desc: Review extracted BOQ items with rates, amounts, pricing additions, and the evidence needed for estimator review.
for_procurement_title: Publish clearer tenders before suppliers ever see them.
for_procurement_desc: Procurement teams can use Tender Engine to review draft tender packs, spot ambiguous BOQ items, and reduce clarification cycles before publication.
value_procurement_1: Tender Health Reports for draft documents
value_procurement_2: Flags for unclear specifications, missing quantities, and risk areas
value_procurement_3: Visible confidence scoring for governance and review
pricing_title: Free during early beta, with guided pilots available.
pricing_desc: Start with the public demo, create an account for live processing, or contact us for a structured team pilot.
early_beta_desc: For contractors and procurement teams evaluating Tender Engine during beta.
pilot_teams_desc: For companies and public offices that want a guided tender-processing pilot.
trust_title: Honesty Architecture is the product philosophy.
trust_desc: Tender Engine should help you move faster without encouraging blind trust. That is why uncertainty, warnings, failed stages, and confidence scores are treated as first-class output.
trust_card_1_desc: Every major extraction stage reports reliability in plain view.
trust_card_2_desc: Useful results can still be shown when one stage needs review.
trust_card_3_desc: Warnings point people toward the parts that deserve attention.
built_for: Built for the teams that build Africa.
built_for_desc: Tender Engine is designed in collaboration with contractors, estimators, and procurement professionals who work with South African tenders every day.
testimonial_quote: The transparency is what sold us. We can see exactly where to trust the output and where to double-check — that's the kind of tool you can actually use on real bids.
cta_title: Ready to see Tender Engine in action?
cta_desc: Try the live demo or create a free account to process your own tender documents.
